reason: The landlord said he would do the work himself (event-007, event-010). On 6 Sept he claimed completion on 31 August (event-012) and added details on the sockets and a dehumidifier (event-014). This is a claim, not proof. There is no invoice, photo or contractor detail, and no assigned provider. The claim is also thin: it says nothing about a replacement smoke alarm or closing the ceiling opening. Only one back-bedroom socket and one kitchen socket are mentioned, though the tenant reported several sockets (event-005). The dehumidifier suggests a possible damp issue in the bathroom that was never reported to us, so I need severity and health impact (damp_mould policy). The tenant has not been heard from since event-001. A working smoke alarm is a legal requirement, so I am not closing, and I am not escalating because nothing reports active danger and the tenant can supply the facts. I asked the tenant to confirm the alarm, ceiling, sockets and bathroom, and asked the landlord for detail and evidence. Follow-up in 72 hours. If the tenant says the alarm is missing, sockets are still loose or there is mould with health impact, escalate. The agency has not approved or instructed anything. The record update the landlord asked for should wait for confirmation.
message: Dear Nessa, the landlord has told us the work at 8 Brindlefern Walk was completed on 31 August. Before we update our record, could you please confirm: (1) Is a smoke alarm now fitted and working on the upstairs landing, and is the ceiling opening closed? (2) Have the loose plug sockets been fixed? If any are still coming away from the wall, please tell us which rooms. (3) The landlord says he gave you a dehumidifier for the bathroom. Is there damp or mould in the bathroom, and if so, how bad is it? Photos would help. Kind regards, Ivo Merrick, Northbridge Lettings
